_about: Townsfolk line catalog for generate_voice_lines.py (AI Townsfolk doc, section 5.7). Lines say what to speak and in which tone; 'emotions' turns each tone into Chatterbox settings and the lip-sync mood; 'profiles' are synthetic voice archetypes. Slots ({place}) list the values to render; every combination becomes its own clip, so prosody stays natural. No line may name a player.

model.licence: MIT; output carries Resemble's Perth watermark

references._about: Each profile clones a synthetic reference clip spoken by a Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0) British voice, never a real person's recording.
references.text: Morning comes slow to Silverbrook. The river runs high this time of year, and the mill wheel turns from first light until the bells ring for supper.

emotions._about: tone -> Chatterbox exaggeration (0.25-2; 0.5 is neutral), cfg_weight (lower is slower and more deliberate), and the MetaHuman Audio Driven Animation mood used when lip sync is baked.

profiles.desc: Older working man; tired and dry

lines.text: Busy. Find someone else to bother.
Mind yourself, stranger. Some of us have work to do.
Put that away! Please, I've done nothing!
Heard someone cleared the bandits out of {place}. Brave fool, whoever it was.
You're the one from {place}, aren't you? Well. Still busy, though.
I know what you did. Stay away from me.
Fish prices at the wharf are a crime, I tell you. A crime.
Halt! You there, stop where you are!
Keep the peace in Silverbrook, traveller.
